correctness.rationale: Direct original multiplication in the quotient yields independent vertex and arrow equations. The complete case split gives a globally trivial affine arrow fiber over every color/zero diagonal torus stratum. Disjoint finite-field counts give the formula for any prime power; finite irreducible-stratum geometry proves dimension and top-component multiplicities, while distinct exponential-polynomial bases prove inverse reconstruction over a fixed finite field. The standalone direct-multiplication checker passed 17 exhaustive small configurations including GF(4); its finite scope does not substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural all-arity ordered-annihilation invariant of a broad quiver-algebra family, not merely a renamed commuting probability. It determines exact counts across all finite-field characteristics and looped multiquivers, a genuine geometric top-dimensional component multiplicity, a sharp induced-density threshold and a fixed-q reconstruction of the induced-edge polynomial. These statements are independent of small numerical examples and are motivated by zero-product substructure and quiver geometry.
